sections.label: Shop API
sections.description: The Vendure server this environment reads products, collections, carts, customers and orders from, through its public Shop API.

fields.name: shopApiUrl
fields.label: Shop API URL
fields.description: The full address of the Shop API endpoint. Without it, the storefront cannot reach the shop.

fields.name: channelToken
fields.label: Channel token
fields.description: Selects a channel of a multi-channel Vendure server; sent as the vendure-token header. Leave empty for the default channel.

fields.name: languageCode
fields.label: Language override
fields.description: A Vendure language code sent with every request, e.g. en. When empty, the visitor's language is sent.

sections.label: Checkout
sections.description: Vendure has no hosted checkout: shoppers check out on a page of this storefront that holds the Vendure Checkout section.

fields.name: checkoutPath
fields.label: Checkout page
fields.description: The path of the page with the Vendure Checkout section, where the cart's Checkout button leads. When empty, /checkout.

fields.name: providerPaymentMethods
fields.label: Payment methods paid with a provider
fields.description: Codes of the shop's payment methods that need a payment provider's own form or redirect, such as a Stripe or Mollie method, separated by commas. The checkout cannot take payment with them yet and shows them as not available. Leave empty when every method completes without one.

sections.label: Admin API
sections.description: Optional. With both fields, the shop's texts can be translated with Translatr and its assets appear in Studio's media library. Without them, the storefront works as before and neither is offered.

fields.name: adminApiUrl
fields.label: Admin API URL
fields.description: The full address of the Admin API endpoint (Vendure 3.6 or later).

fields.name: adminApiKey
fields.label: Admin API key
fields.description: An API key of a role holding only the permissions the app's README lists. Sent as the vendure-api-key header.
